description: Implementation of ProductAttributeDao for accessing product attribute data from the database, including methods for retrieving product attributes by various criteria.

classes.name: ProductAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for ProductAttribute, providing methods to query product attributes based on various parameters.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductAttribute by its ID, fetching related entities.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific merchant store and option ID.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves ProductAttributes matching a list of attribute IDs for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves ProductAttributes associated with a specific option value ID and merchant store.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves ProductAttributes for a specific product, store, and language.
